Method of Attack: Replacing the official Windows wallet installer with a suspicious file to potentially steal cryptocurrencies and/or user information
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running the Bitcoin Gold wallet
Attack Vector: Compromise of the official GitHub repository hosting the wallet installer
Date of Discovery: Between November 21, 2017, 09:39 UTC and November 25, 2017, 22:30 UTC
Repository URL: GitHub repository of Bitcoin Gold wallet installers
